title: manageUnits
responsibility: Indexes and checks registered units, reports relationship and canonical ownership diagnostics, and retires source-free identities.

inputs.name: indexUnits.options
inputs.description: Selects the source root and whether the fresh manifests are written; omitted options default to {}, and write defaults to false. loadUnits uses process.cwd() when root is omitted, while json and now are not read here.

inputs.name: checkUnits.options
inputs.description: Selects the source root; omitted options default to {}, and loadUnits uses process.cwd() when root is omitted. json, write, and now are not read by this operation.

inputs.name: registryErrors.loaded
inputs.description: Loaded context contains stored and freshly indexed manifests, a source index, scenarios, loading errors, formatting gaps, and the registry repository. registryErrors combines those facts with contract, preview, UID, scenario-reference, ownership, and staleness checks.

inputs.name: retireUnit.id
inputs.description: ID of a stored unit manifest to retire; an unknown ID throws ExpectedCliError. Retirement is allowed only when no path in that manifest's owns.source remains in the loaded source index.

inputs.name: retireUnit.reason
inputs.description: Nonblank text saved as retired.reason; an empty or whitespace-only string throws ExpectedCliError. The original string, including surrounding whitespace, is stored unchanged.
examples: Superseded after its source was removed.

inputs.name: retireUnit.options
inputs.description: Selects the root passed to loadUnits and may provide now, a callback whose returned string is stored as the retirement time; omitted options default to {}. Without now, the current time is stored with toISOString(); json and write are not read.

inputs.name: renderIndex.report
inputs.description: Contains added, updated, moved, revived and orphaned unit IDs, active-unit count, written paths and uncertain-reference count. renderIndex uses those lists to format change lines and may add a write instruction.

inputs.name: renderIndex.wrote
inputs.description: Indicates whether the caller reports that writing was performed; when false, the rendered output includes a write instruction only if there are additions, updates or moves. It does not affect the report contents.

inputs.name: renderCheck.report
inputs.description: Contains active-unit and uncertain-reference counts plus optional warnings, contract-failure summaries and registry errors. The renderer uses the counts in its summary and appends each warning as a separate line.

outputs.name: indexUnits
outputs.description: Returns change lists from fresh indexing, the count of active fresh manifests, paths actually written, and uncertain-reference count. It writes manifests only when options.write is truthy; otherwise written is empty.

outputs.name: checkUnits
outputs.description: Returns the stored active-manifest count, uncertain graph-reference count, fresh and stored contract-failure summaries, storage warnings, and registry error strings. These diagnostics are returned in the report; awaited dependencies may still reject.

outputs.name: registryErrors
outputs.description: Returns strings for load errors, stored and fresh contract findings, active-unit preview bindings, registry and UID validation, unknown scenario or unit references, and stale-index changes.
examples: Registry is stale; run harness units index --write (1: add workflow.manage-units)

outputs.name: retireUnit
outputs.description: Returns the retired manifest after writing it, preserving its existing fields while changing status and adding the supplied reason and retirement time. It can proceed only for a known unit with a nonblank reason and no still-owned source path.

examples.title: manageUnits
examples.responsibility: Indexes and checks registered units, reports relationship and canonical ownership diagnostics, and retires source-free identities.

retired.reason: Superseded after its source was removed.

outputs.name: renderIndex
outputs.description: Returns the formatted index summary, move and orphan lines, uncertainty count, and, when wrote is false and additions, updates or moves exist, a write instruction. It does not display full manifest data or written paths.
examples:
Indexed 1 units: 1 added, 0 updated, 0 moved, 0 revived.
0 uncertain references.
Run again with --write to update specification/units.

outputs.name: renderCheck
outputs.description: Returns the valid-registry summary with active-unit and uncertain-reference counts, followed by one Warning: line per warning when present. The message does not include report.errors or contract-failure counts.
examples: Units registry is valid: 1 units, 0 uncertain references.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown by fail when the ID is unknown, the reason is empty after trimming, or any owned source path still exists in the source index. Rejections from loadUnits or repository.write also propagate, but are not constructed as ExpectedCliError here.
